Subject: Renewal + mid-cycle top-up — PO and tax form for invoicing

Hi Leah —

Congrats on the expanded commit — excited to see Zenova ramp. Quick housekeeping so finance can issue the prorated invoice for the mid-cycle capacity top-up: can you please confirm the PO number we should reference and attach the appropriate tax form (W-8 BEN-E or equivalent)? We typically need: 
- PO PDF with billing entity and remit-to
- Tax form for your entity (W-9 if US, W-8 BEN-E if foreign)
- Billing contact for invoice questions and remittance email

If you share the PO today we’ll generate a prorated invoice covering the period from 2027-04-01 to your renewal date (2027-07-01) and include the one-time credit we discussed for the service interruption in January.

I’ll loop in our finance lead (Marissa) and account lead (Vivek) so they can coordinate the exact invoice lines.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Renewal + mid-cycle top-up — invoice details and proration calc

Hi Oliver / Leah —

Thanks for the PO and W-8. I reviewed the PO and tax form — everything looks in order for us to bill Zenova Health International. Attached is the proration worksheet showing the token-hours and cost lines for the period 2027-04-01 through 2027-07-01. 

Key notes: 
- Gross invoice before credits: $74,200
- Applied one-time goodwill credit: $18,500
- Net prorated invoice: $55,700

Payment terms: your PO indicates Net 60; you previously requested Net 45 in the renewal conversation. Finance has approved Net 45 for this prorated invoice as a one-time term for the first renewal invoice. For future invoices we will default to Net 60 unless an update is signed in the amendment.

Next steps for you: 
1) Confirm that ZH-PO-987654 should be the invoice reference (we have it matched).
2) Confirm remittance email for electronic delivery (is oliver.cheng@zenovahealth.com the right address for accounts payable?).
3) If you'd like the invoice routed to a different legal entity (US parent vs. international), notify us now — otherwise we'll bill the international entity per the W-8.

I have attached the proration_calc.xlsx for your records. Once you confirm I’ll issue the invoice and send the DocuSign link for a short amendment confirming Net 45 for the first invoice and the credit application.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: proration_calc.xlsx

Hi Leah / Oliver —

Thanks — confirming receipt of ZH-PO-987654 and the W-8 BEN-E. We’ve generated the prorated invoice (INV-2027-04-ZH987654) for $55,700 and set payment terms to Net 45 per Marissa’s note. The invoice has been sent to oliver.cheng@zenovahealth.com and to your finance@zenovahealth.com mailbox for remittance. 

I’ve also sent a short DocuSign amendment to Leah at leah.moss@zenovahealth.com to authorize the Net 45 exception for the first invoice and the application of the one-time credit. Please sign when convenient; the DocuSign expires in 7 days. Link: https://www.docusign.com/embedded/signing/abc123-prorate

If you prefer ACH details instead of the invoice PDF, let me know and I’ll have treasury provide the file.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to a smooth renewal.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
